[[Muga Riptide]] is a [[Mergoyle]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[D'Alessio Seaboard]] [[mission]] as well as [[Talmark Wilderness]].

* [[Kryta]]

* [[Mergoyle Skull]]
* [[Scale]]

== Notes ==
* In the D'Alessio Seaboard mission, it shares two points with [[Plook Wavebreaker]], [[Rago the Scaled]], and [[Skigg the Tongue]].
* Consider [[Signet of Capture|capturing]] Blessed Signet from him, as it is not available until the [[quest]] [[The False Gods]], acquired in [[Temple of the Ages]].

==Trivia==
*According to the Guild Wars: Official Game Guide, Muga Riptide originally had the elite skill [[Healing Hands]].
